messages:
Maya Shah: Heads up, a batch of tiny-gang jobs are stuck Pending in ap-southeast1. Scheduler shows lease timeouts and 'orphaned-gpu-satellites' in the logs.
Chris L: Any specific node family or pool affected?
Maya Shah: Mostly mixed g4dn-like racks. Pods require strict gang affinity. Sample event: 
```
Events:
  Type    Reason   Age  From       Message
  ----    ------   ---  ----       -------
  Warning Failed   90s  scheduler  lease renewal failed for gpu-lease-7b2c
  Normal  Pending  89s  kubelet    waiting for full gang allocation
```
Raj Patel: "orphaned-gpu-satellites" often means the lease-controller missed keepalives. Any NAT/SNAT pressure or conntrack spikes in that AZ?
Infra Oncall: We saw SNAT port reuse spike at ~10:10 UTC on a subset of racks. NAT gateway ephemeral ports were saturated, and some nodes started failing outbound connections.
Chris L: That would drop lease renew traffic and make the controller assume satellites are gone. Also saw kubelet heartbeats delayed; could be NTP drift too.
Maya Shah: Node 12 shows kubelet heartbeat 3m stale; node clock is ~2 minutes fast.
Raj Patel: Two concurrent failure modes then: ephemeral port exhaustion causing TCP drops and time skew causing TTL mismatches. For short-term mitigation: restart lease-agent daemonset on affected nodes and cordon the highest-SNAT nodes to avoid new gang placements.
Infra Oncall: Initiated DS rolling restart. Cordon + migrate in progress.
deploy-bot: Lease-agent daemonset restart requested by @Infra Oncall.
Chris L: Long-term fixes: (1) increase NAT capacity or split egress for those racks, (2) add jitter to lease renews & lower interval under high-loss networks, (3) enforce chrony/ntp via node bootstrap (kubeadm hooks), (4) introduce a scheduler soft-affinity retry window so transient lease flaps don't block full gang placement.
Raj Patel: Also add conntrack alerts per-AZ and a runbook to detect SNAT exhaustion early. Document the lease TTL behavior in the scheduler playbook.
Maya Shah: After restart, controller re-registered most satellites. Around 40/44 pods progressed to Assigned and started GPU init. Still watching for stray failures.
Infra Oncall: Filing incident with NAT metrics, conntrack logs, and node NTP state. Will follow up with timeline and a planned NAT capacity uplift.
Maya Shah: Thanks, team. I'll assemble a short postmortem once stable. :thumbsup:
